target: EleosHook.process(address) public tax-split caller bounty on Elysium
why: No caller payout. Verified EleosHook source (official Elysium explorer getsourcecode, scratch/EleosHook.sol:417-481) shows process(address) is public but all collected HYPE goes to platform, creator, holder dividends, buyback or locked liquidity; neither process nor payCreator/payPlatform pays msg.sender. Fresh-address eth_call of process(EOS) reverts TooEarly() 0x085de625, not a role error, because processable(EOS) returns false with 0.004699613390083377 HYPE pending below MIN_PROCESS=0.005 HYPE. taxNow(EOS)=100/100 bps validates the address. An executor cannot earn native/USDC profit from this public job.
next_steps: Closed for caller-reward strategy. Reopen only if a new verified deployment/source explicitly adds a caller payout; this says nothing about separate DEX price-gap strategies. Evidence: scratch/eleos-source-response.json, scratch/EleosHook.sol, scratch/eleos-process-stranger-call.json; official docs https://eleos.fun/docs.
